hazards.evidence: Raised exterior door sill/threshold at the base of the front door that a walker user must step/roll over.
Scene is at dusk and the concrete step treads are in shadow; only one small wall lantern is lit to the right of the door, leaving the steps poorly illuminated.
Plain concrete steps with no contrasting nosing/edge marking, so tread edges are hard to distinguish in the dim light.
Overall exterior approach is dark (twilight) with a single porch light; the walkway and entry are largely in shadow for an arriving walker user.
